faqs.question: What makes an entryway work day to day?
faqs.answer: A place to sit, a place to drop keys and mail, hooks or a closet for coats, a rug that handles wet shoes, and good light. We plan those first, then the mirror, art and finishes.

faqs.question: How wide does a front door and its landing need to be?
faqs.answer: Oregon's 2023 residential code requires at least one exit door with 32 inches of clear width and 78 inches of clear height, and a landing at least 36 inches deep on each side of an exterior door. Your contractor confirms the details; we plan the furniture around them.

faqs.question: How much does entryway design cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scope, from a single consultation to full-service design. We quote after the discovery call. Our guide to [what an interior designer costs in Portland](/blog/interior-designer-cost-portland) explains how designers usually charge.

faqs.question: Can you add a mudroom to a home that doesn't have one?
faqs.answer: Often. A wall near the garage or back door can take hooks, a bench and closed storage. If it needs built-in cabinetry, we design it and your contractor or cabinetmaker builds it.

factChecks.quote: shall provide a clear width of not less than 32 inches (813 mm) where measured between the face of the door and the stop, with the door open 90 degrees (1.57 rad).
The clear height of the door opening shall be not less than 78 inches (1981 mm) in height measured from the top of the threshold to the bottom of the stop.

factChecks.claim: Landing on each side of each exterior door
factChecks.quote: There shall be a landing or floor on each side of each exterior door.
Landings shall have a dimension of not less than 36 inches (914 mm) measured in the direction of travel.
Stairways shall be not less than 36 inches (914 mm) in clear width at all points above the permitted handrail height and below the required headroom height.
The headroom in stairways shall be not less than 6 feet 8 inches (2032 mm)
The riser height shall be not more than 8 inches ( 203 mm).
The tread depth shall be not less than 9 inches ( 229 mm).
